prompt: How is the LDAP administrator account configured when the `rootdn` and `rootpw` directives are not present in `slapd.conf`?
choices: The default account `admin` with password `admin` is used
The default account `admin` is used without a password
The account is defined by an ACL in `slapd.conf`
explanation: Without `rootdn`/`rootpw`, administrative access is governed by the access-control (ACL) rules in the configuration.
